items.claim: Valter Walker has strong wrestling abilities stemming from his background.
items.quote: he's a Brazilian who grew up in Russia, so he can wrestle

items.claim: Valter Walker has poor cardio and fatigued quickly in previous performances.
items.quote: got a couple of takedowns, gassed, looked like [ __ ] and got beat

items.claim: Valter Walker has undergone a massive physical transformation for this fight compared to previous bouts.
Valter Walker's striking technique is not very good.
items.quote: Valter Walker, his striking is not very good.

items.claim: Valter Walker has demonstrated durability and a good chin after absorbing heavy shots from Luis Sutherland.
items.quote: He does have a chin on him. We saw that when Luis Sutherland absolutely blasted him.

items.claim: Valter Walker relies heavily on trying to force fights to the ground.
items.quote: he really is just trying to get these fights to the ground as desperately as humanly possible.

items.claim: Thomas Peterson is a strong American wrestler, which will make Valter Walker's grappling path difficult.
items.quote: he's fighting Thomas Peterson, just a a corn-fed American wrestler.
